data_scope: Full validation set (val_lr / val_xgb parquets), 283,026 rows

definitions.ece: Weighted mean |frac_pos - mean_pred| per bin; quantile, n_bins=10
definitions.noskill_baseline: Always predict observed validation-set default rate

important_distinction: ROC-AUC measures discrimination (ranking ability) and is rank-based. Brier Score and ECE measure calibration (probability reliability). These are independent properties. Post-hoc calibration rescales scores but does not change their ranking order, so ROC-AUC is unaffected.
